test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The constant noise from the construction site next door is starting to __make me extremely angry__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom of the sentence is: **'make me extremely angry'.__**
 
• The appropriate Idiom of the underlined segment is: **'drive me up the wall'.**
 
• The Idiom **'drive me up the wall'** means to make someone extremely angry.
 __
 
• **Example**: *My flat-mate is **driving me up the wall**.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'drive me up the wall'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'bringing me round'** means ​to persuade somebody to agree to something. 
 
• **'shove me under the table'** means a secret, hidden action.
 
• **'driving me blind'** means unable to see ahead.
